applies_why: The judge text addresses whether Matthew 1:20 was answered and does not count it as an unanswered witness.
quote: D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- the challenger's covenant-origin analogy is footed (1 Chronicles 28:6, Acts 1:8) but the sentence's own words state the source of what is in the womb; answered in [CR3] LINK 2.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
room: Phrase: 'count it' — I weighed (1) counting an answered verse as an unanswered witness against (2) merely noting that it was answered; the judge does the latter.
why: The judge expressly says Matthew 1:20 was answered in [CR3] LINK 2 and does not count it as an unanswered witness, so the answered-verse prohibition is obeyed.
